# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- Generated by scripts/reference-docs.sh from the code. Do not edit by hand: change the code and run scripts/reference-docs.sh (the pre-commit hook fails when this file is stale). -->

Every shortcut of the app, from the one catalog the menus take their keys from and Settings › Shortcuts lists (53 entries). The editor's keys work when the editor has the focus and you are not typing; the teleprompter's keys also come from pedals and presentation remotes.

## File

| Keys | Action | Id |
|---|---|---|
| ⌘N | New project… | `newProject` |
| ⌘T | New Tab | `newTab` |
| ⌘O | Open project… | `openProject` |
| ⌘I | Import media… | `importMedia` |
| ⌘W | Close Tab | `closeTab` |
| ⌘S | Save | `save` |
| ⇧⌘S | Save As… | `saveAs` |
| ⌘, | Settings | `settings` |

## Edit

| Keys | Action | Id |
|---|---|---|
| ⌘Z | Undo | `undo` |
| ⇧⌘Z | Redo | `redo` |

## Editing

| Keys | Action | Id |
|---|---|---|
| ⌘K | Cut at the playhead | `cut` |
| ⇧⌘M | Automatic edit | `autoEdit` |

## Record

| Keys | Action | Id |
|---|---|---|
| ⇧⌘R | Start or stop recording | `record` |
| ⇧⌘P | Pause or resume | `pause` |

## In the timeline

| Keys | Action | Id |
|---|---|---|
| Space | Play or pause | `play` |
| J | Back (J), stop (K), forward (L) | `shuttleBack` |
| ← | One frame back (⇧: one second) | `frameBack` |
| → | One frame forward (⇧: one second) | `frameForward` |
| ↖ | To the start | `start` |
| ↘ | To the end | `end` |
| ⌫ | Delete the selection (⇧: close the gap) | `delete` |
| V | Selection tool | `select` |
| C | Razor tool | `razor` |
| T | Text tool | `text` |
| H | Hand tool | `hand` |
| = | Zoom the timeline in | `zoomIn` |
| - | Zoom the timeline out | `zoomOut` |
| \ | Fit the timeline | `fit` |
| ⌘C | Copy the clips | `copy` |
| ⌘V | Paste at the playhead | `paste` |
| ⌘D | Duplicate the clips | `duplicate` |

## Teleprompter

| Keys | Action | Id |
|---|---|---|
| Space | Start or stop scrolling | `prompterPlay` |
| ↓ | Next sentence (also → and Page Down) | `prompterNext` |
| ↑ | Previous sentence (also ← and Page Up) | `prompterBack` |
| ⌥Space | Start or stop the teleprompter from its window | `prompterToggle` |
